_comment: WHO TELLS WHAT (Jerry, 2026-11-17). The software team does the heavy lifting: every check that looks at the
code underneath (grader/checks.json "looks": "code") is the team's, automatically. The player says only what a
person sees and does on the page. A page check, or one of its aspects, listed here is told by the team too: what
no player sees (tags, console, the opening dice's owner tags) and exact measurements (sizes, ratios, colour
difference, milliseconds), which the team quotes with the grader's own numbers ({measured} in its line).
